1.3.4.name: DrumCraker
1.3.4.author: Wamphyre
1.3.4.description: Free drum sampler VST3 plugin optimized for Linux, FreeBSD, Windows and macOS, fully compatible with DrumGizmo drum kits.
1.3.4.changes:
v1.3.4: 10-16x faster first load via grouped sample decoding, plus a new
on-disk cache (.dcc) for near-instant kit reloads. Fixed several
memory/thread-safety bugs (use-after-free, race conditions, multichannel
reads, cumulative resample quality loss). This is the last release with
prebuilt Windows/FreeBSD/macOS binaries — going forward, DrumCraker ships
as Linux-only precompiled, with other platforms built from source.
